name: Blazhennyj
source:
The protagonist spent so much time in "Sovyonok" that he went crazy. His concepts of morality and ethics were monstrously distorted, and he himself acquired an irresistible craving for torture and brutal rape.

But nothing lasts forever....

And after hundreds and thousands of branches, he finally finds his unenviable end.

Can a murderer sincerely regret his sins? What will happen to him if he gets into our world? And does this promise him anything good? What is the name of the voice in Semyon's head?
translation:
主角在《Sovyonok》里花了太多时间，以至于他疯了。他的道德观念被严重扭曲，他本人也产生了对酷刑和残酷强奸的不可抗拒的渴望。

但没有什么是永恒的……

在经历了成百上千的分支之后，他终于找到了自己令人羡慕的结局。

杀人犯能真诚地悔罪吗？如果他闯入我们的世界，会发生什么？这对他有什么好处吗？谢苗脑子里的声音叫什么名字？
